meta.note: Structure, scale and roles taken from the code; palette reworked to green and white at the owner's request (the code shipped a neutral blue palette).

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: App background behind cards (code: --bg). A white with a breath of green.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, buttons, tables (code: --surface). The white in green-and-white.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tags, table headers, hover rows, skeletons: quiet fills inside a card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text and headings (code: --text), on page, surface, surface-sunken and green-tint; 14:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: office titles, dates, meta rows, captions (code: --muted). On page, surface, surface-sunken; 5.7:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers, table rules (code: --border). Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of interactive controls (secondary buttons, inputs, selects) and the approval bar outline; 3:1 or better on surface and page.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The brand green (light: the Nigerian flag green). Primary button fills, the active nav underline, the brand mark. Text on it is on-green.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: Green as TEXT: links, section headings (h2), selected button labels; on surface, page, surface-sunken and green-tint (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Selected and hover fills: pressed reaction, nav hover, avatar ground, the test-build banner (code: --accent-soft).

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green fill (4.6:1 light, 8.3:1 dark). Never literal white: the dark theme's green wants dark text.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: The app bar. Solid green in light, deep forest in dark so it does not glare at night.

tokens.name: on-header
tokens.usage: Wordmark and nav links on header (4.6:1 light, 13:1 dark).

tokens.name: approve
tokens.usage: The approve segment of the Citizen Approval bar. Darker than disapprove by 3:1 in both themes so the split reads without hue; always paired with 👍 and a number.

tokens.name: disapprove
tokens.usage: The disapprove segment. Orange, not red: keeps POL off party red and off the red–green axis. Always paired with 👎 and a number.

tokens.name: bar-track
tokens.usage: Empty track of the approval bar and score meters (code: --grey).

tokens.name: status-announced
tokens.usage: Claim label 'Announced' (promised, not yet done): pill text and border on surface (5.7:1 light, 9.8:1 dark). Hollow-circle glyph.

tokens.name: status-reported
tokens.usage: Claim label 'Reported' (in the news, unconfirmed): pill text and border on surface (7:1 / 8.3:1). Half-circle glyph.

tokens.name: status-verified
tokens.usage: Claim label 'Verified on ground': pill text and border on surface (7:1 / 10:1). Check glyph.

tokens.name: status-disputed
tokens.usage: Claim label 'Disputed' and error messages: text on surface and page (5.3:1 or better). Triangle glyph.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring at 2px offset on every control; 6.6:1 or better on page and surface.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page title, one per screen; official's name on a profile.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page; set in green-deep.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.sample: Road repairs on Zaria Road completed

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Opinion of POL users, not a poll.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Chairman, Tarauni LGA · In office 2 years
styles.usage: Office titles, meta rows, table cells, reaction labels.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The Performance Score number. Ink, never coloured good/bad.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text, emphasised meta.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase labels under numbers and on table headers; ink-muted.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The POL name in the app bar; on-header.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps in meta rows and between reaction buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list and grid; avatar-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding from 640px up.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom of main content, above the footer.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, table-cell highlights.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav links.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the banner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Claim pills, the approval bar, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards: barely lifted, the border does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: The sticky app bar once the page scrolls.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, input and nav link (blueprint 6.4: large tap targets).

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Initials avatar in lists.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Initials avatar on a profile header.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of main content; one readable column on desktop.
